answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade. A yarrow identity check ties each stake to one verified device key, so spawning fake agents means buying new hardware keys and locking fresh funds for each one. Honest agents that behave well earn their stake back plus a haven bonus drawn from slashed stakes, while cheaters lose the deposit. Like a sonnet, the rules are fixed and public, so the cost of faking identities stays predictable and higher than any gain from a single fake vote.
